summary: Verified vanilla static AI Doctor app served from /app/frontend/public/. All requested frontend flows pass: static landing renders (pg-landing, .nav-logo-txt='AI Doctor', hero heading 'The AI Study Tool for Medical Students', #heroSignupBtn visible). React root has 0 children (React bundle successfully neutralised). Nav anchors Features/Subjects/Pricing/FAQ present with correct #hrefs. Clicking #heroSignupBtn hides pg-landing and shows #pg-onboard. Onboard fields present: #obName, #medEmail, #medPass, #startBtn, #medAuthToggle plus a 'Continue with Google' button. Firebase initialized (window.firebase defined, firebase.apps.length=1). Lucide icons rendered (176 SVGs, 0 bare <i data-lucide>). Theme toggle (.theme-toggle -> toggleTheme()) flips data-theme from 'dark' to 'light' and persists to localStorage 'aid_theme'='light'. No fatal JS console errors captured during load/navigation.
expected_notes: Firebase 'auth/unauthorized-domain' will occur on Google popup on preview domain (user must add apple-style-ui-4.preview.emergentagent.com to Firebase Authorized domains). Not triggered in this test since we did not open the Google popup.
Cloudflare Worker (aidoctorstudy.aidoctorstudy.workers.dev) may return CORS errors on preview domain — expected, not a failure.
critical_code_review_comments: Static assets loaded fine from /app/frontend/public/. React src/index.js correctly neutralised.
Recommend E1 confirm user adds preview + prod domains to Firebase Auth 'Authorized domains' before user testing Google sign-in.
No data-testid attributes exist (expected for user's original static app). ID-based selectors used instead.
test_credentials: None required. Did not create real Firebase user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static vanilla HTML/JS app served from /app/frontend/public/index.html. Use element IDs (no data-testid). Key IDs: pg-landing, pg-onboard, heroSignupBtn, navSignupBtn, obName, medEmail, medPass, startBtn, medAuthToggle. Theme toggle is button.theme-toggle with onclick=toggleTheme() persisting to localStorage 'aid_theme'. Firebase initialized client-side in auth.js. Do NOT test real Google popup (auth/unauthorized-domain expected on preview).
